title: The Verdier dual of a Weil complex is a Weil complex
statement:
Let $k_0$ be a finite field, $k$ an algebraic closure, and $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}k_0$ a prime. Fix $\Omega=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$ and use the finite-subextension-valued condensed ring $\underline\Omega$ [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed], not the discrete constant ring. For a finite-type $k_0$-scheme $T_0$, put $\bar T=T_0\times_{k_0}k$, $R_{\bar T}=p_{\bar T}^*\underline\Omega$ [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients], $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{Mod}(R_{\bar T})$, and $P_T=g_T^*$ for geometric Galois Frobenius $g_T=1\times\operatorname{Spec}(\operatorname{Frob}_q^{-1})$ [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. Let $\mathcal W_T=\mathcal A_T^{P_T}$ be the category of sheaves with invertible Frobenius structure [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. Define $\mathrm{WC}(T_0)$ to be the full subcategory of the ordinary derived category $D(\mathcal W_T)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] consisting of the objects with bounded cohomology whose cohomology sheaves have constructible underlying $R_{\bar T}$-modules, meaning a finite locally closed constructible stratification with pro-etale locally finite free restrictions [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. This is the derived-sheaf convention of the live Lean `AlgebraicGeometry.WeilComplex`, rather than the category of fixed pairs in a geometric derived category.

Let $X_0$ be separated and of finite type over $k_0$, with structure morphism $a_0:X_0\to\operatorname{Spec}k_0$. Assume its compact-support functor $Ra_{0!}:\mathrm{WC}(X_0)\to\mathrm{WC}(\operatorname{Spec}k_0)$, formed by equivariant extension by zero and derived proper pushforward along the chosen compactification on Frobenius-equivariant sheaves [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework] (Lean `WeilComplex.derivedLowerShriek`), has a right adjoint $Ra_0^!$ on these same categories. Put $\omega_X=Ra_0^!\Omega$, where $\Omega$ denotes the constant equivariant coefficient sheaf on the geometric point in degree zero. For $K\in\mathrm{WC}(X_0)$ let $H_P(K,\omega_X)$ denote the product-Hom construction of [lem-sf-weil-native-closed-forgetful]; this is the live Lean `ProEtaleWeilSheaf.derivedHom` applied to $K$ and `dualizingComplex`. Then $H_P(K,\omega_X)$ belongs to $\mathrm{WC}(X_0)$. Restricting the ambient contravariant Hom functor therefore defines $D_X:\mathrm{WC}(X_0)^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{WC}(X_0)$.

proof.text: The assumed constructible right adjoint defining the actual dualizingComplex has codomain WeilComplex, so its value omega_X is a Weil complex. Apply [lem-sf-weil-geometric-hom-constructibility] to K and omega_X. Its third clause gives bounded constructibility (and finite Tor amplitude) of CondensedRing.derivedHom(UK,Uomega_X), for the specified functor U = nativeGeometricForget.
